analogy.rationale: GLI antagonists block the terminal Hedgehog pathway transcription factors, so smoothened receptor antagonists act on the same pathway and should give the most similar response, while gamma secretase inhibitors affect upstream Notch/Hedgehog crosstalk. Because GLI1/2 are transcription factors and the pathway is largely inactive in these cell lines, the overall transcriptional response is expected to be weak.
